An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the IOFramebufferUserClient IOkit user client. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. title: Apple macOS IOFramebufferUserClient Race Condition Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
